name: Guni
title: Son of Naphtali
summary: Guni was a son of Naphtali, who in turn was the son of the patriarch Jacob and his wife Bilhah. Guni was one of those who went down to Egypt with Jacob's family and became the ancestor of the Gunite clans in the tribe of Naphtali. There is also another Guni mentioned in 1 Chronicles who belonged to the tribe of Gad.

keyEvents.title: Born as a son of Naphtali
keyEvents.description: Guni was born as one of four sons of Naphtali, Jacob's sixth son through Bilhah, Rachel's maidservant.

keyEvents.title: The Journey to Egypt
keyEvents.description: Guni was among Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt during the famine, when the whole family settled in Goshen.

keyEvents.title: Enumeration among Jacob's descendants
keyEvents.description: Guni is mentioned in the list of Naphtali's sons in Jacob's genealogy, confirming his place in Israel's tribal structure.

keyEvents.title: The Gunitic clan is established
keyEvents.description: Guni's descendants formed the Gunitic clans during the wilderness wanderings and were recorded in the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogical register of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Guni is listed as a son of Naphtali in the extensive genealogy in 1 Chronicles, confirming his role in Israel's tribal history.
